spine: 1. 同一個虛擬位址理論上永遠對應同一顆 DRAM cell（&x == &x），skitter-creek-bath-salts 的作者示範，只要改記憶體控制器的暫存器，這件事就不成立。
2. 假設一：MMU 與頁表的 U/S、NX、SMEP/SMAP 等權限位元擋住越權存取——但這些機制管的是 CPU load/store 指令能不能碰某個實體位址，不管記憶體控制器的 MMIO 組態暫存器，也不參與實體位址如何被重寫成 DRAM 座標。
3. 假設二：SMRAM lock、PSP carveout 這些 firmware／晶片組層的 fence 總該擋住——但作者指出這些機制全部建立在實體位址座標系上，「the fences guard physical addresses, not DRAM coordinates」，只要同一顆 DRAM cell 換一個門牌號碼，舊鎖就跟著脫鉤。
4. 破口：一行 `xor dword [0xf80c2094], 0x00400000` 翻轉 DCT 裡的 bank-swizzle-mode 位元，就能讓實體位址對應到 DRAM 的另一顆 cell，證明保護鏈確實只到 MCT/DCT 之前為止。
5. 因為位址轉換是 GF(2) 上的線性映射，作者用 sentinel 值＋掃記憶體拿到 (target, alias) 配對，餵給 z3 反解出轉換矩陣，把原本要查（未公開）手冊的問題，變成收集資料就能解的線性代數問題。
6. 驗證：同一套流程讀出 PSP 的 fTPM RSA 引擎、SMRAM 的 SMI handler 入口、C6 省電狀態存的 CPU 暫存器、以及 C6 附帶備份的 microcode patch，四個獨立案例共用同一個破口。
7. 可推廣性：作者測試僅限 AMD Family 16h（之後世代的資料手冊不再公開這些暫存器），但主張 channel/rank/bank interleave 這類架構在 AMD、Intel、ARM、RISC-V 上普遍存在；同一手法能否在其他架構上重建轉換矩陣，repo 本身沒有給出實測證據，屬於合理推測而非已示範的結論。

perspective.mechanism: 位址轉換鏈在 CPU/MMU、快取一致性、data fabric 都各自加了保護，但最後一段——記憶體控制器把實體位址重寫成 DRAM 座標的 MCT/DCT——在 AMD Family 16h 上沒有鎖，翻一個組態暫存器位元就能讓同一顆 DRAM cell 被兩種不同的位址同時定址，再用 GF(2) 線性代數把打散前後的對應關係解回來。
perspective.tradeoff: 示範完全依賴 AMD Family 16h 資料手冊仍公開這些暫存器位置這個前提；作者自己承認 17h 之後手冊不再寫這些細節，且部分逆向出的暫存器（如 C6 stash 裡的其他內部狀態）連作者自己都不確定用途，方法論的可推廣性目前只是設計上的合理推測，repo 裡沒有其他架構的實測資料。
perspective.reader_use: 評估一層記憶體保護是否真的鎖住某段資料時，不能只確認實體位址範圍被防火牆或 lock bit 圍住，還要往下問：這個實體位址在真正落地儲存媒介之前，是否還經過一段自己管轄範圍之外、沒有被單獨鎖定的轉換階段——GPU 顯示記憶體、NVMe FTL、甚至跨機器的分散式儲存系統裡都可能有類似的『最後一段轉換』。

notes.quote: Unlocking **everything** on the CPU with DRAM scrambling — PSP, C6, microcode, SMM, and anything else the specs left out.
notes.interpretation: 專案標題／tagline，定調整個 repo 的主張範圍：PSP、C6、microcode、SMM 全部可被同一種手法讀出。

notes.quote:
`&x == &x`.

Usually.
notes.interpretation: 全文的鉤子：同一位址通常指向同一 DRAM cell，這個「usually」就是整篇 repo 要打破的假設。

notes.quote: Poke the DRAM controller and an address can be made to land wherever you want in memory. `skitter-creek-bath-salts` modifies the bottom layers of the memory hierarchy to rewire the physical DRAM address translations. This scrambles platform memory, exposing protected regions of DRAM — carveouts invisible even to the kernel. When the address translations break, so do the security primitives built on them, and we unlock *everything*.
notes.interpretation: 核心主張：改記憶體控制器的位址轉換，就能讓建立在其上的所有安全機制一起失效。

notes.quote: Developed and tested on **AMD Family 16h CPUs**, the last generation whose datasheets document the DRAM controller's translation registers — and show that they can't be locked. 17h and beyond simply leave this information out.
notes.interpretation: 測試範圍與前提：僅在 AMD Family 16h 上開發測試，之後世代的資料手冊不再公開這些暫存器資訊——不代表機制消失，只是逆向門檻變高。

notes.quote: The [odyssey of `*p`](#the-odyssey-of-p) is similar across generations and architectures, and the underlying transforms extend even to ARM, RISC-V, and beyond; `skitter-creek-bath-salts` shows us [**only how to begin**](#the-shared-pipeline).
notes.interpretation: 作者對可推廣性的主張，語氣上是斷言，但 repo 本身只在 AMD Family 16h 上有實測資料，跨架構的部分屬於作者觀察與展望，本文將其標記為推論而非已驗證結論。

notes.quote: This project works at the deepest levels of the `*p` pipeline, the MCT/DCT layer — where a physical address from the data fabric/interconnect enters the memory controller and is rewritten one final time into the raw DRAM coordinates that are issued to the DIMM.
notes.interpretation: 指出攻擊發生在 `*p` 管線的最底層：MCT/DCT 把實體位址重寫成 DRAM 座標的那一步。

notes.quote:
```nasm
xor dword [0xf80c2094], 0x00400000
```

That's the exploit. All of it.
notes.interpretation: 整個漏洞利用只有一行 MMIO 寫入指令，翻轉 DCT 的 bank-swizzle-mode 位元。

notes.quote: One bit-flip in the DRAM controller rewires the bottom of the `*p` pipeline, and the data that was at `&x` is now somewhere else mid-flight. Suddenly `&x != &x`. Every mechanism the CPU, firmware, uncore, and chipset use to wall off protected memory sits above the memory controller, and none of it sees what happens below. The fences guard physical addresses, not DRAM coordinates; rearrange the coordinates and the barriers above never notice.
notes.interpretation: 解釋為什麼上層所有保護都失效：所有 fence 建立在實體位址上，不參與記憶體控制器如何把實體位址重排成 DRAM 座標。

notes.quote: But rewiring DRAM is easy. The bit above is the bank-swizzle-mode in the DCT, and it's just one of dozens that control the address remaps at the final layer — all you have to do is poke them to make everything built on top topple.  The harder part then is keeping the platform up as the entirety of system memory is scrambled underneath it.
notes.interpretation: 指出真正的工程難點不是找到可翻的暫存器（有幾十個），而是翻轉之後平台還要撐住不當機。

notes.quote: The trick: be fast, and *don't touch DRAM*. Disable the APs, prime the TLBs, warm the cache, disable interrupts, flush the target, serialize memory accesses, and hope the CPU prefetched the upcoming instructions. Then rewire the MCT/DCT to spaghettify DRAM, grab some data from the protected region, revert the mappings, serialize again, enable interrupts, resume the APs, and the platform is back to normal.
notes.interpretation: 維持平台穩定的完整步驟：停用 AP、預熱 TLB/快取、關中斷、flush 目標、序列化，翻轉窗口內完成讀取後立刻復原。

notes.quote:
mov eax, [0xf80c2094]          ; prime mmio TLB
mov eax, [0x6f800000]          ; prime target TLB
pushf                          ; preserve flags
cli                            ; interrupts off
clflush [0x6f800000]           ; evict the target, force the dram read
mfence                         ; barrier - no coherent world dram access
lfence                         ;   reordered into spaghettified view
xor dword [0xf80c2094], 1<<22  ; flip dct swizzle → spaghettify dram
mov ebx, [0x6f800000]          ; fetch target in spaghettified view
xor dword [0xf80c2094], 1<<22  ; restore dct swizzle → unscramble
mfence                         ; barrier - no spaghettified dram access
lfence                         ;   reordered into coherent world view
popf                           ; interrupts back on
notes.interpretation: 完整組合語言示例，用於文中的 pseudocode 程式碼區塊（省略了兩行 lfence 以縮短篇幅，其餘逐行對應）。

notes.quote: But there's a challenge: while we can reprogram the translation with a simple `xor dword [0xf80c2094], 0x00400000`, we have no idea what new transforms the MCT/DCT will use (the datasheets are underspecified here — the xor maps are off, the MMIO subtractive stage is unordered, and details vary across models). Without this, memory scrambles, but we have no way to reconstruct it.
notes.interpretation: 指出資料手冊本身不足以重建新的轉換關係，逼出後面的逆向工程方法。

notes.quote: Fortunately, the DRAM controller's address transform is a GF(2) linear map, which means we can reconstruct the scrambled memory with basic linear algebra.
notes.interpretation: 解法的數學基礎：位址轉換是 GF(2) 上的線性映射，因此能用線性代數重建。

notes.quote: To find the alias, compose the inverse of the attacking/spaghettified hash with the forward of the firmware/coherent hash, to get the translation that will reach any secret from the malicious MCT/DCT configuration
notes.interpretation: 矩陣合成的具體做法：M_attacker 的逆矩陣乘上 M_firmware，得到能到達任何 secret 的轉換。

notes.quote: Start in the coherent view, modify the MCT/DCT to switch to the spaghettified view, drop some sentinel value like `0xdeadc0de` into a random address in memory, flip back to the coherent view, and sweep memory for where the sentinel resurfaces. This gives a (target, alias) pair — a concrete datapoint showing two physical addresses that map to the same cell in DRAM. Repeat the process, gather a handful of data, pass it to z3, and it solves the translation matrix needed to convert between the two views
notes.interpretation: 資料收集方法的完整敘述：sentinel 值＋掃記憶體拿到 (target, alias) 配對，餵給 z3 解轉換矩陣。

notes.quote: The solved transform is a rosetta stone: any target address in the coherent view maps to an alias that reaches the same DRAM in the spaghettified view.
notes.interpretation: 解出的矩陣可以重複使用，任何想讀的位址都能套用算出別名。

notes.quote: In the end, everything so carefully walled off — PSP private memory, SMRAM, the C6 idle-state, inaccessible from the OS, ring-0, sometimes the CPU itself — is still sitting in the same DRAM capacitors. But the locks were built around the coherent view of memory, and do nothing against a spaghettified alias reaching the same cell.
notes.interpretation: 總結性論點：保護區與一般記憶體共用同一批 DRAM 電容，鎖只綁定正常視角，對別名視角無效。

notes.quote: Flip one bit in the final level of the `*p` pipeline, and we've unlocked everything.
notes.interpretation: 全篇的收束句，呼應標題「Unlocking everything」。

notes.quote: The fTPM runs on the PSP's own ARM core, in a DRAM carveout right past the visible top-of-memory. Reach it by aliasing an OS-visible physical address onto it, pull the bytes out, disassemble.
notes.interpretation: PSP 案例的起點：fTPM 的私有 DRAM carveout 位置，以及讀取方法。

notes.quote: Resolve the PSP DRAM carveout — sets PSP_BASE / PSP_SIZE (0x7f800000 / 0x800000 on the test box).
notes.interpretation: 測試機上實測到的 PSP carveout 位置與大小。

notes.quote: Carve crAmd_ModExp (0x64 bytes at PSP_BASE+0x19d4) straight out of the captured image.
notes.interpretation: crAmd_ModExp 函式在 PSP carveout 裡的具體位移與大小。

notes.quote: That's the PSP's RSA engine — the modexp behind every fTPM signature, and behind the Miller-Rabin tests that mint its keys — lifted out of memory the PSP is supposed to own alone, fenced off at the memory controller, opaque even to ring-0.
notes.interpretation: 讀出的內容具體是什麼：fTPM 的 RSA 模指數運算函式 crAmd_ModExp，以及它在 fTPM 簽章與金鑰產生中的角色。

notes.quote: The SMI handler entry vector lives at `SMBASE + 0x8000`. `SMBASE` is in MSR `0xc0010111`.
notes.interpretation: SMRAM 案例的定位方法：SMI handler 入口位址與對應的 MSR。

notes.quote:
mov eax,0x6efe2ff8      ; SMM stack top
mov esp,eax             ; install the SMM stack
notes.interpretation: SMI handler 進入之前換上的 SMM 專用堆疊頂端位址。

notes.quote: Those instructions run in ring -2, the most privileged context on the CPU, out of memory the chipset is supposed to make unreadable. SMRAM "locked" turns out to be a polite suggestion when we can talk to the DRAM controller directly.
notes.interpretation: SMRAM lock 在這個攻擊面前形同虛設的評語。

notes.quote: When the cores power-gate into C6, each one's full x86 architectural context is stashed here for restore.
notes.interpretation: C6 案例背景：核心進省電狀態時，完整架構狀態存進 DRAM 供喚醒後還原。

notes.quote: Resolve the C6 stash — sets CC6_BASE / CC6_SIZE (0x7f000000 / 0x800000 on the test box). Each idle core's state lives in a 16 KiB save area; four cores here, at CC6_BASE + {0, 0x4000, 0x8000, 0xc000}.
notes.interpretation: 每核心 save area 為 16 KiB，四核心各自佔一段。

notes.quote: One core with the BSP bit set, three without — the boot processor and its three APs, caught mid-idle with their register state lying in the open.
notes.interpretation: 四核心 dump 裡只有 core 0 的 IA32_APIC_BASE 帶 BSP bit（0xfee00900），其餘三顆是 0xfee00800（application processor，見 README 表格）。

notes.quote:
| `+0x8b0` | GS / per-cpu base | `0xffff9be4e3600000` |
| `+0x9a0` | CR3 (page-table root) | `0x0fd46000` |
| `+0x9b8` | IA32_APIC_BASE | `0xfee00900` |
| `+0xa38` | variable MTRR (base/mask) | `0x6f000000 / …0800` |
| `+0xb10` | saved RIP | `0xffffffff8f3a0029` |
notes.interpretation: core 0 從 C6 stash 讀出的具體架構暫存器數值表：GS base、CR3、APIC_BASE、MTRR、saved RIP。

notes.quote: *I have no idea what's in here and have never seen it discussed, likely internal CPU registers. Have fun.*
notes.interpretation: 作者自己承認 C6 stash 裡除了已知架構暫存器之外，還有一批內容未知、無人討論過的資料——這是本案例的一個明確限制。

notes.quote: Of course, those registers are all accessible from ring-0 anyway. The *fun* part is in all the *other* CPU state sitting there — poking the internal CPU registers ring-0 can't reach.
notes.interpretation: 作者自己指出已示範的暫存器（CR3、IA32_APIC_BASE 等）本來 ring-0 就查得到，真正新穎的部分是未知的內部狀態。

notes.quote: When a core drops into C6 its microcode patch RAM — volatile SRAM — goes dark with the rest of the core. So the C6 stash keeps the loaded patch in DRAM and re-seeds it on wake. That copy sits at `+0x1800` in each save area, and the alias reaches it like any other byte.
notes.interpretation: microcode 案例的機制：C6 時 SRAM 上的 microcode patch 斷電消失，DRAM 裡留一份備份供喚醒重載。

notes.quote: fam16h: 68/94 chunks match     <- the microcode the core is running
notes.interpretation: 驗證讀出的 microcode 屬於 fam16h：與官方檔案逐塊比對命中 68/94 塊。

notes.quote: From there, `dram_dump` has a sibling tool, `dram_poke`. The same alias that read the patch can write it — and this copy is the one the core reloads coming out of idle.
notes.interpretation: 同一組別名位址不只能讀還能寫，且這份 DRAM 副本正是喚醒後重載的那份 microcode patch。

notes.quote: Channel interleave, rank interleave, bank interleave, swizzle, chip-select normalize — every modern memory controller does some version of all of it. AMD. Intel. ARM. RISC-V. Mobile. Server. Embedded. The same architectural shape sits underneath everything.
notes.interpretation: 作者對記憶體控制器架構共通性的主張——語氣斷言，但 repo 本身只在 AMD Family 16h 上有實測，跨架構部分本文標記為合理推測。

notes.quote: *Above* it all sits SEV, SGX, TDX, TrustZone, CCA realms, pKVM, CoVE, SEP, the PSP, ME, T-SEG, SMRAM, the C6 stash. Everything sitting in DRAM — even things walled off and invisible to ring-0 or the CPU itself — rests on the final layers of a `*p` pipeline we've just begun to explore.
notes.interpretation: 列出理論上會受同一種轉換層弱點影響的技術清單，包含多家廠商的機密運算方案。

notes.quote: The exploit demonstrated here is one configuration register on AMD Family 16h, picked because the datasheets gave enough to begin. The *pipeline* it broke is everywhere.
notes.interpretation: 作者自陳這次示範只是「開始」，選 AMD Family 16h 只是因為手冊資訊夠用。

notes.quote: `skitter-creek-bath-salts` is a research effort from Christopher Domas ([@xoreaxeaxeax](https://x.com/xoreaxeaxeax/))
notes.interpretation: 作者歸屬：Christopher Domas。

notes.quote: * Black Hat 2026 — Spaghettifying DRAM (Coming Soon)
notes.interpretation: 研究已排進 Black Hat 2026 議程，但正式簡報尚未發布，細節未定，屬於時效性較短的未來事件資訊。

notes.quote: ⇒ ~5× walks per single guest walk
notes.interpretation: 巢狀分頁（nested paging）下，一次 guest page walk 會放大成約五倍的實際 walk 次數——出現在 README 的 `*p` 管線 ASCII 圖裡，用來說明位址翻譯這條路徑本身的成本。

claims.note: sentinel 常數、(target, alias) pair、z3 解矩陣的敘述皆逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 「a rosetta stone: any target address in the coherent view maps to an alias that reaches the same DRAM in the spaghettified view」
claims.evidence: The solved transform is a rosetta stone: any target address in the coherent view maps to an alias that reaches the same DRAM in the spaghettified view.
claims.note: 逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 「The fences guard physical addresses, not DRAM coordinates; rearrange the coordinates and the barriers above never notice.」
claims.evidence: Every mechanism the CPU, firmware, uncore, and chipset use to wall off protected memory sits above the memory controller, and none of it sees what happens below. The fences guard physical addresses, not DRAM coordinates; rearrange the coordinates and the barriers above never notice.
claims.note: 整段英文引文逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: 「SEV, SGX, TDX, TrustZone, CCA realms, pKVM, CoVE, SEP, the PSP, ME, T-SEG, SMRAM, the C6 stash」全部 sits above 記憶體控制器
claims.evidence: *Above* it all sits SEV, SGX, TDX, TrustZone, CCA realms, pKVM, CoVE, SEP, the PSP, ME, T-SEG, SMRAM, the C6 stash.
claims.note: 清單逐項相符；「sits above」為對 README 兩處敘述的合理縮引，非捏造。

claims.claim_text: 「everything so carefully walled off ... is still sitting in the same DRAM capacitors. But the locks were built around the coherent view of memory」
claims.evidence: In the end, everything so carefully walled off — PSP private memory, SMRAM, the C6 idle-state, inaccessible from the OS, ring-0, sometimes the CPU itself — is still sitting in the same DRAM capacitors. But the locks were built around the coherent view of memory, and do nothing against a spaghettified alias reaching the same cell.
claims.note: 整段收束引文逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: fTPM 跑在 PSP 的 ARM 核心，讀出 crAmd_ModExp——fTPM 簽章與 Miller-Rabin 金鑰產生背後的 modexp
claims.evidence: The fTPM runs on the PSP's own ARM core, in a DRAM carveout right past the visible top-of-memory. ... the modexp behind every fTPM signature, and behind the Miller-Rabin tests that mint its keys
claims.note: PSP/ARM core、carveout 位置、crAmd_ModExp 角色描述皆逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: PSP_BASE 是 0x7f800000，PSP_SIZE 是 0x800000
claims.evidence: Resolve the PSP DRAM carveout — sets PSP_BASE / PSP_SIZE (0x7f800000 / 0x800000 on the test box).
claims.note: 兩個常數逐字相符。

claims.claim_text: crAmd_ModExp 釘在 PSP_BASE+0x19d4，函式體只有 0x64 bytes
claims.evidence: Carve crAmd_ModExp (0x64 bytes at PSP_BASE+0x19d4) straight out of the captured image.

claims.evidence: mov eax,0x6efe2ff8      ; SMM stack top ... add eax,0x803a  ; EAX = SMBASE+0x803a, the 32-bit handler entry ... retfd

claims.claim_text: SRAM 裡的 microcode patch 會斷電消失，所以 CPU 先把它備份進 DRAM（C6 save area 的 +0x1800）
claims.evidence: When a core drops into C6 its microcode patch RAM — volatile SRAM — goes dark ... So the C6 stash keeps the loaded patch in DRAM and re-seeds it on wake. That copy sits at `+0x1800` in each save area
claims.note: 因果機制與位移皆與 README 相符。
